verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no version pinning, lockfile, or update-control mechanism for installed plugins or skills. Plugins install from marketplaces, and the docs state that after initial publication, MCP server changes are picked up automatically and eligible updates go live once they pass automated checks, which is the opposite of team-controlled rollout. The ability to check skills into a repo folder relies on the team's own source control, a user-side workaround rather than a product versioning feature, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can control when skill changes reach my team — pinned versions or a lockfile rather than silent behind-the-back updates
